en:
Object Sensor

Introduction

The objectdetector class is used to measure reflectivity and detect objects by the Object Sensor.

Class Constructor

objectdetector( 
  triport::port &port, 
  bool           bReverse = false );

Class Destructor

Destroys the objectdetector object and releases associated resources.

virtual ~objectdetector();

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
port triport::port & The 3-Wire Port that the Object Sensor is connected to, written as Brain.ThreeWirePort.X or ExpanderName.X, where X is the port letter (for example, Brain.ThreeWirePort.A or Expander1.A).
bReverse bool An optional boolean to reverse the direction of the Object Sensor:
  • false (default) — Do not reverse the direction
  • true — Reverse the direction

    Examples

    // Create an objectdetector instance in Port A
objectdetector ObjectSensorA = objectdetector(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A, true);

    Member Functions

    The objectdetector class includes the following member functions:

    • reflectivity — Returns the reflectivity detected by the Object Sensor.
    • isObjectDetected — Returns whether the Object Sensor detects an object.
    • setDetectionThreshold — Sets the detection range of the Object Sensor.
    • objectDetected — Registers a function to be called when the Object Sensor detects an object.
    • objectLost — Registers a function to be called when the Object Sensor loses an object.

    Before calling any objectdetector member functions, a objectdetector instance must be created, as shown below:

    // Create an objectdetector instance in Port A
objectdetector ObjectSensorA = objectdetector(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A, true);

    reflectivity

    Returns the reflectivity measured by the Object Sensor.

    Available Functions

    int32_t reflectivity( 
  percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct );

    Parameters

    Parameters Type Description
    units percentUnits The unit that represents the reflectivity:
    • percent / pct — percent

    Return Values

    Returns an int32_t representing the reflectivity measured by the Object Detector as a percent in the range 0 - 100%.

    Examples

    // Display the detected reflectivity on the Brain's screen
int32_t value = ObjectSensorA.reflectivity();
Brain.Screen.print(value);

    isObjectDetected

    Returns whether an object is currently detected by the Object Detector.

    Available Functions

    bool isObjectDetected();

    Parameters

    This function does not take any parameters.

    Return Values

    Returns a Boolean indicating whether an object is detected:

    • true — An object is detected.
    • false — No object is detected.

    setDetectionThreshold

    Sets the detection threshold for the Object Detector to a specific value.

    Available Functions

    void setDetectionThreshold( 
  int32_t      threshold, 
  percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct );

    Parameters

    Parameters Type Description
    threshold int32_t The reflectivity threshold for object detection, in the range 0 - 100.
    units percentUnits The unit that represents the new threshold:
    • percent / pct — percent

    Return Values

    This function does not return a value.

    Examples

    // Set the reflectivity threshold to 50%
ObjectSensorA.setDetectionThreshold(50);

    objectDetected

    Registers a callback function for when an object is detected.

    Available Functions

    void objectDetected(void (* callback)(void));

    Parameters

    Parameter Type Description
    callback void (*)(void) The callback function to be called when an object is detected.

    Return Values

    This function does not return a value.

    Examples

    Define the callback function (outside of int main())

    // Display a message when an object is detected.
void detected() {
  Brain.Screen.print("object detected");
}

    Register the callback inside int main()

    int main() {
  // Run detected when the Object Detector detects an object.
  ObjectSensorA.objectDetected(detected);
}

    objectLost

    Registers a callback function for when an object is lost.

    Available Functions

    void objectLost(void (* callback)(void));

    Parameters

    Parameter Type Description
    callback void (*)(void) The callback function to be called when an object is lost.

    Return Values

    This function does not return a value.

    Examples

    Define the callback function (outside of int main())

    // Display a message when an object is lost.
void lost() {
  Brain.Screen.print("object lost");
}

    Register the callback inside int main()

    int main() {
  // Run lost when the Object Detector loses an object.
  ObjectSensorA.objectLost(lost);
}
zh:
物体检测传感器

概述

objectdetector类用于测量反射率并通过物体传感器检测物体。

构造函数

objectdetector( 
  triport::port &port, 
  bool           bReverse = false );

析构函数

销毁objectdetector对象并释放关联资源。

virtual ~objectdetector();

参数

参数 类型 说明
port triport::port & 物体传感器连接的三线端口，写作Brain.ThreeWirePort.X或ExpanderName.X，其中X是端口号（例如，Brain.ThreeWirePort.A或Expander1.A）。
bReverse bool 用于反转物体传感器方向的可选布尔：
  • false（默认） — 不反转方向
  • true— 反转方向

    示例

    // Create an objectdetector instance in Port A
objectdetector ObjectSensorA = objectdetector(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A, true);

    成员函数

    objectdetector类包含以下成员函数：

    • reflectivity— 返回物体传感器检测到的反射率。
    • isObjectDetected— 返回物体传感器是否检测到物体。
    • setDetectionThreshold— 设置物体传感器的检测范围。
    • objectDetected— 注册当物体传感器检测到物体时要调用的函数。
    • objectLost— 注册一个在物体传感器丢失物体时调用的函数。

    在调用任何objectdetector成员函数之前，必须创建一个objectdetector实例，如下所示：

    // Create an objectdetector instance in Port A
objectdetector ObjectSensorA = objectdetector(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A, true);

    reflectivity

    返回物体传感器测量的反射率。

    函数重载

    int32_t reflectivity( 
  percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct );

    参数

    参数 类型 说明
    units percentUnits 表示反射率的单位：
    • percent/pct— 百分比

    返回值

    返回int32_t，表示对象检测器测量的反射率，以 0 - 100% 范围内的百分比表示。

    示例

    // Display the detected reflectivity on the Brain's screen
int32_t value = ObjectSensorA.reflectivity();
Brain.Screen.print(value);

    isObjectDetected

    返回对象检测器当前是否检测到对象。

    函数重载

    bool isObjectDetected();

    参数

    此函数不接受参数。

    返回值

    返回一个 布尔 指示是否检测到对象：

    • true— 检测到物体。
    • false— 未检测到物体。

    setDetectionThreshold

    将对象检测器的检测阈值设置为特定值。

    函数重载

    void setDetectionThreshold( 
  int32_t      threshold, 
  percentUnits units = percentUnits::pct );

    参数

    参数 类型 说明
    threshold int32_t 对象检测的反射率阈值，范围为 0 - 100。
    units percentUnits 代表新阈值的单位：
    • percent/pct— 百分比

    返回值

    此函数无返回值。

    示例

    // Set the reflectivity threshold to 50%
ObjectSensorA.setDetectionThreshold(50);

    objectDetected

    注册检测到对象时的回调函数。

    函数重载

    void objectDetected(void (* callback)(void));

    参数

    参数 类型 说明
    callback void (*)(void) 检测到对象时调用的回调函数。

    返回值

    此函数无返回值。

    示例

    定义回调函数（在int main()之外）

    // Display a message when an object is detected.
void detected() {
  Brain.Screen.print("object detected");
}

    在int main()内部注册回调函数

    int main() {
  // Run detected when the Object Detector detects an object.
  ObjectSensorA.objectDetected(detected);
}

    objectLost

    注册一个对象丢失时的回调函数。

    函数重载

    void objectLost(void (* callback)(void));

    参数

    参数 类型 说明
    callback void (*)(void) 回调函数是当对象丢失时调用的函数。

    返回值

    此函数无返回值。

    示例

    定义回调函数（在int main()之外）

    // Display a message when an object is lost.
void lost() {
  Brain.Screen.print("object lost");
}

    在int main()内部注册回调函数

    int main() {
  // Run lost when the Object Detector loses an object.
  ObjectSensorA.objectLost(lost);
}
